scope: 333 original menu cases and 76 additional types; source-level assessments, not a full-client parity certificate
source_policy: Assessments are tied to the 2026-10-02T04:03:51Z evidence index and the documented inspection window, not an atomic/final worktree. Per-file SHA-256 and subsequent drift are recorded. Newer source files must not be treated as absent merely because they postdate this index. Baseline build 36953914277 does not validate this worktree.

later_worktree_changes: Post-index additions include glass rendering, native history retention, localization UI, profile editors/photos, player controller, plugin contributions, Apple translation and streaming AI. They are recorded in validation source_drift_since_snapshot and test fingerprints, not silently promoted or declared absent by the older row snapshot.

normalization.rows: Each tuple uses row_columns. Join case to evidence_index.rows[case]; key must match. That record preserves the exact original case address, item accessor/callsite records, associated-value encoding, state-field type/encoding, candidate callbacks/accessors and exact literal candidates. Never substitute port_kind for the original item type.
normalization.types: Join each additional_types tuple by name to evidence_index.additional_types; all descriptor fields, encodings, image IDs and addresses are preserved there.
normalization.contracts: numeric_contracts and semantic_contracts override the explicit unknown default/range in the evidence index. All other defaults/ranges remain null (not recovered), including Boolean defaults. Getter fallbacks are not necessarily slider defaults or ranges.
normalization.evidence_limits: Name-matched preference/callback records are candidates, not proven bindings. An absent cstring is not proof of an absent inline Swift key. Source mentions and routes are not by themselves consumers.
normalization.owner: assigned_owner is inherited from families[family] and materialized for every row/type in expanded_inventory.
normalization.presentation: Headers and static text use S and are excluded from operational counts. Status text with a real producer is assessed separately. Types are structures, not 76 independent functions.
normalization.expansion: Run the audit-owned validate_inventory.py to validate joins and create a standalone expanded JSON with original metadata, current evidence, per-row owner/status, contracts and family tasks. Repository files are edited only with apply_patch.
